summary: Verified the reported bulk-upload dialog close bug is FIXED. As Super Admin, opened Colleges → Bulk upload dialog, uploaded a valid CSV (name/courses/place/deal_with/sc_rates), the success celebration appeared, and the dialog CLOSED on a single click of the footer 'Done' button while the celebration was still visible. Computed styles confirm both .celebrate-backdrop and .celebrate-card have pointer-events:none (with z-index:9999), so the transient centered overlay is click-through and no longer intercepts the dialog's Close/Done control. Cleaned up the test college created during testing.
observations: Colleges bulk upload flow works end-to-end: template download, file input, submit, success result banner (bulk-result), success toast, and celebration overlay.
Celebration overlay computed styles at runtime: backdrop_pointerEvents='none', card_pointerEvents='none', backdrop_zIndex=9999 → fully click-through, matches spec.
Dialog closed on a single 'Done' click; data-testid=bulk-dialog removed from DOM immediately.

Colleges delete uses a native browser confirm() (window.confirm) rather than a Radix AlertDialog — works, but inconsistent with the rest of the app's UX (non-blocking for automated tests only when page.on('dialog', accept) is registered). Not a regression; minor UX-consistency nit for main agent to consider.
critical_code_review_comments: CollegeCard delete flow uses native window.confirm — consider replacing with the existing shadcn AlertDialog pattern to match Students/Leads delete UX.
index.css contains two @layer base blocks (line 7 and line 180); merge for cleanliness (cosmetic, no functional impact).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_College_CleanupZZ college during upload test; deleted after verification. Final Colleges count restored to 9.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk upload dialog close bug on Colleges is fixed. Same CSS fix applies to Students bulk-upload (student-bulk-dialog) and Leads bulk-upload (leads-bulk-dialog) since the CelebrationOverlay is app-wide and the pointer-events:none is on the shared classes. If retesting, use native dialog auto-accept when deleting colleges: page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept())).
rca of the issue: Previously .celebrate-card had pointer-events:auto and sat above Radix Dialog (z:9999 vs z:50), intercepting the Done/X click. Fix in /app/frontend/src/index.css sets pointer-events:none on both .celebrate-backdrop and .celebrate-card, making the entire celebration overlay non-blocking while still visually shown and auto-dismissed after ~1.7s.
